purpose: Falsify learning principles designed for covariate shift and structural change, rather than tune an existing return model.

point_in_time.training_rule: Every fitted target and every environment observation is strictly earlier than the first scored date of its month.
point_in_time.source_rule: candidate_price_source_max_date is null or strictly earlier than score date
point_in_time.target_day_outcome_mutation_test: For the final fold replace every scoring outcome and label, rerun every scorer and selection rule, and require exact scores, masks, and selected keys.

portfolio.slot_weights: Each slot has fixed weight 1/capacity; rejected or unavailable slots remain cash and surviving slots are not renormalised.

control.definition: Expanding Ridge(alpha=1) on 2 * within-date average percentile rank(return) - 1, forced top-k.
control.comparison: Each candidate/capacity is compared with this control at matching capacity.

prohibited_reuse: Changing only an alpha, threshold, quantile, window length, decay rate, or number of regimes of an existing model
Ordinary expanding or rolling continuous-return regression
M09 temporal median of prediction scores
Any grid search or outcome-selected window, threshold, cluster count, change point, or environment partition

implementation_lock.prediction_preprocessing: Fold-local median imputation with missing indicators and standardisation.
implementation_lock.market_state_preprocessing: One row per strictly prior training date; median imputation and standardisation fit inside the fold.
implementation_lock.target: Within-date rank target used by the control; no candidate changes the target.
implementation_lock.training_weight: Each training date has total base weight one.
implementation_lock.environment_classifier: SGDClassifier log-loss, alpha=0.0001, max_iter=100, tol=0.0001, random_state fixed; old/recent classes receive equal total weight.
implementation_lock.old_recent_split: First 70% versus final 30% of unique training dates.

change_point.algorithm: Maximise the norm of the standardised pre/post mean contrast over every split with at least 40 dates on each side.
change_point.reset_rule: Train only on and after the selected split date.
change_point.failure_rule: If fewer than 80 training dates or fewer than 20 post-reset dates are usable, hold cash.

invariant_sign.rule: Retain transformed features whose Ridge coefficient sign is identical in all three era fits, then refit pooled Ridge using only retained coordinates.
invariant_sign.failure_rule: If no coordinate is retained, hold cash.

implementation_lock.leave_one_state_out: Fit three pooled rank Ridges, each excluding one latent state; aggregate coefficients and intercepts coordinate-wise by median.
implementation_lock.latent_experts: Fit one rank Ridge per latent state and route by the nearest point-in-time KMeans centroid; if any state has fewer than 20 dates, the whole mechanism holds cash.

support_conformal.decision: Rows outside support hold cash; supported rows retain control ordering.

implementation_lock.environment_residualisation: Remove from every standardised prediction row its orthogonal projection onto the old/recent classifier coefficient vector, then fit one pooled rank Ridge in that residual representation; zero environment direction fails closed.

hypotheses.mechanism: Classify old versus recent feature rows without labels, convert corrected recent-class odds to a clipped density ratio, renormalise within each date, and fit one pooled rank Ridge.
hypotheses.prediction: Training observations whose feature support resembles the recent environment deserve more influence even when every historical date remains available.

hypotheses.mechanism: Detect the maximum multivariate market-state mean contrast using no return labels and discard all target observations before that change point.
hypotheses.prediction: A structural break in the observable pre-open environment invalidates earlier label relationships enough that a clean reset generalises better.

hypotheses.mechanism: Use multiplicative Group-DRO weights over calendar-month training environments so that months with the largest rank loss drive a minimax-like pooled model.
hypotheses.prediction: Coefficients that reduce the worst historical environment loss are more stable than average-risk ERM under future shifts.

hypotheses.mechanism: Require coefficient direction to agree across three chronological eras, discard sign-unstable coordinates, and refit a single pooled model on the invariant representation.
hypotheses.prediction: Directionally stable relationships are less likely to encode era-specific shortcuts.

hypotheses.mechanism: Discover three label-free market states, fit one model while omitting each state in turn, and aggregate coefficients rather than predictions by coordinate-wise median.
hypotheses.prediction: A parameter vector that survives removal of any one market state is robust to state-composition shift without routing or temporal ensembling.

hypotheses.mechanism: Cluster multivariate daily market state without outcomes, fit three state-specific experts, and route score-date rows to the nearest latent state.
hypotheses.prediction: Multivariate latent environments expose distinct conditional mappings not captured by the observed two-way dispersion split.

hypotheses.mechanism: Use a finite-sample conformal quantile of feature nonconformity in the most recent training era and reject unsupported score rows to cash without consulting outcomes.
hypotheses.prediction: Abstaining outside recent covariate support protects against extrapolation failures while retaining the same return ordering inside support.

hypotheses.mechanism: Learn the linear direction that separates old and recent feature environments, remove that direction from the representation, and fit return ranks only on the residual subspace.
hypotheses.prediction: Suppressing the most time-discriminative feature direction removes temporal shortcuts and improves stability under distribution shift.

reported: best and worst 5/10/20 days removed at net20
executed slots, traded days, cash days, unique codes
largest and top-10 code weight share
top-10 positive-P&L codes replaced by cash at net20
evaluation.multiplicity: 5000 deterministic circular moving-block resamples, block length 10 sessions; studentised one-sided 95% familywise max-t lower bound for net40 uplift versus capacity-matched control across all 16 policies.
evaluation.selection_rule: Among candidates passing every retrospective gate, freeze the highest net40 mean; freeze none when no candidate passes.

production_gate.artifact_freeze: Exact mechanism, representation, hyperparameters, capacity, cash rule, code, and hashes are frozen before forward outcomes.
production_gate.failure_action: Reject the finalist; require a new registered mechanism and future period rather than tune this family.
